scenario: the first practical exchange about restaurants & cafés
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Restaurants and Cafés
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: restaurants & cafés — the first practical exchange about restaurants & cafés
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about restaurants & cafés; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan orders a pot of tea from Ms Sophie at a café.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan gọi một ấm trà từ chị Sophie tại quán cà phê.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Sophie. Could I have a pot of tea, please?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Sophie. Cho tôi một ấm trà nhé.

turns.speaker: Ms Sophie
turns.english: Right away. Would you like a snack too?
turns.vietnamese: Có ngay đây. Chị dùng thêm bánh nhẹ không?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: No, that is everything, thank you.
turns.vietnamese: Không, vậy là đủ rồi, cảm ơn chị.
